desc: Implement the full algorithm (pref/suff/prev precomputation + iterative lazy segment tree with range add / point set / range max + right-cut sweep) and verify it produces 5 and 9 on the two samples.
Stress-test edge cases: N=3, all-same values, all-distinct values, prev[j]=0 boundary, and confirm correct handling of the last valid right cut j=N-1.
Check performance at N=3e5 with the iterative segment tree and confirm it runs within limits.
